notes:
FORMS:
⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (meet) + {談|だん} (talk, discuss)

USAGE:
Used for formal discussions between leaders, officials, or representatives — typically in diplomatic or political contexts. Implies greater formality and importance than ordinary ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧ (meeting).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧{会談|かいだん}: summit meeting
- ⟦{日米|にちべい}→日米：13092_nichibei⟧{会談|かいだん}: Japan-US talks
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧{会談|かいだん}: telephone conference
- {会談|かいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold talks
- {会談|かいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{申|もう}し{入|い}れる: to request a meeting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: meeting (general, any participants)
- {会談|かいだん}: talks (formal, usually leaders/officials)
- ⟦{対談|たいだん}→対談：19950_taidan⟧: dialogue, interview (often published or broadcast)
- ⟦{面談|めんだん}→面談：08177_mendan⟧: interview, private meeting (often one-on-one)
